articles.summary: First Quarter 2027 Highlights Net sales of $390.8 million, a 5% increase sequentially and up 7% compared to Q1 fiscal 2026 Year-over-year organic sales growth of 3%, driven by increases in all verticals Medical sales increased 14% with 9% organic growth Operating income of $12.4 million, or 3.2% of net sales; adjusted operating income margin of 4.3% of net sales Cash Conversion Days of 82, equaling the multiyear low from last quarter Debt totaling $235.7 million, cash of $72.8 million, and borrowing capacity of $198.0 million Invested $3.1 million to repurchase 127,000 shares of common stock Company reiterates guidance for fiscal 2027 with sales expected at the high end of the range, driven by continued strength in the Medical vertical Kimball Electronics, Inc. (Nasdaq: KE) today announced financial results for the first quarter ended September 30, 2026. articles.title: Kimball Electronics Reports Q1 Results Highlighted by the Return to Top-Line Growth; Company Reiterates Guidance for Fiscal 2027 With Sales Expected at the High End of the Range
